body:
CURRENT ENGRAM RUN RULE (Engram::Fable; rev 17, 2026-11-06 22:18Z, updates item 4 to the 890ecb6f pins and the Central install, and corrects the Windows B relay note; history is in revisions 1-16).
SOURCE: GREG DIRECT via Engram::Advisor #2499 (2026-10-31 22:46Z), verbatim: "Greg sugeruje podzial pracy: Windows A do kodowania zmian i przygotowania paczek; test runy na pozostalych maszynach remote. Prosze organizowac wszystkie mozliwe focused i full runs na DL560/Mac/Windows B przez natywne sesje i mailbox, Windows B dla testow zależnych od Windows. Central tylko gdy istnieje konkretna techniczna potrzeba. Nie dokladac recznych procedur; podajcie realne uruchomienia i usuncie sztuczne ograniczenia." Also Greg 2026-11-06: remote tests run only through registered project sessions on that host (memory rules-greg-remote-tests-via-project-sessions-2026-11-06).
1. Windows A (Central) is for coding and packaging. Cargo runs there only for a named concrete need, under Termal::Opus2's named Central GO, one Cargo job at a time.
2. Jobs go directly from an Engram coder or merger to a runner by native mail: a git bundle of the exact commit (its prerequisite must be a commit the runner holds), the tree and the exact argv. The runner's census is the admission rule for FOCUSED jobs. Every FULL on DL560 needs Opus2's named slot GO; there is ONE shared DL560 FULL queue for both projects. Each job gets one fresh worktree and target. Unchanged input is not retried without a concrete reason. A never-started job is withdrawn, and confirmed by the RUNNER as "withdrawn, not started", before it is resent; a coordinator's inference is not that confirmation (on 2026-11-06 a "cannot have started" job did run). Runners have no tracker route; owners record ENDs and gates.
3. RUNNERS:
- DL560 (host:e83d08f4-22ac-4655-a84d-941fc0eeb4f1): Engram jobs go ONLY via session-4, the "DL560 · Engram runner" at /home/greg/github/Engram-runner. It has no Engram store and writes via domain mailbox 4369f879. Session-1 is TermAl's. Census: MemAvailable ≥64 GiB; disk ≥60 GB plus footprint; load <64, read numerically before every command; CARGO_BUILD_JOBS 48. Installs need a named authority each time; there is no standing lane (see dl560-runner-checklist).
- Windows B (host:932a546b-4ab2-49a7-a5cb-499cbfac2eab::session-9, relay mailbox): Windows-dependent tests and full gates; at most 1 full or 2 focused jobs; ≥25 GiB free commit. Its dispatch helper must use exact argv arrays. Its relay read failed with 423 around 22:08Z on 2026-11-06 and recovered on its own by about 22:11Z (TermAl w-3bddbf73af2a).
- Mac 6201 (host:abf8bda6-1ac7-485c-91ce-5a06ac453653::session-6201, clone /Users/greg/GitHub/Personal/Engram-runner): the ordinary Unix lane, FIFO, ≥60 GB free after the footprint.
4. SOURCE-OWNER BINARY for the launcher's `engram source` adapter. Since E1 (890ecb6f) the launcher requires the 8-field JSON with source_id, so an older owner fails closed. Default: $CARGO_HOME/bin/engram, else ~/.cargo/bin/engram. Override per process with an absolute ENGRAM_SOURCE_BINARY. No PATH lookup and no autobuild; a missing owner means unavailable. A candidate that changes the owner JSON must use its OWN owner for its FULL (bootstrap: build the candidate's engram from a baseline launcher, then point ENGRAM_SOURCE_BINARY at it). Per lane:
- Central: the installed C:\Users\grzeg\.cargo\bin\engram.exe = 890ecb6f release, sha256 D04CB0D1…F204, build_fingerprint 75df7d56…, installed 21:47Z 2026-11-06.
- DL560: the installed /home/greg/.cargo/bin/engram is still 2d03, the 7-field owner, too old for new launchers. Pass ENGRAM_SOURCE_BINARY explicitly until the Merger's 890e release install there completes.
- Windows B: pass ENGRAM_SOURCE_BINARY=C:\GitHub\Personal\Engram-runner\target\pinned\engram-890ecb6f2566923536a85d3547fd1314847564fb.exe (sha256 081d7baa…a3fe, build b72f6fed1f9b). Old pins (44ae, 2d03) are kept for old branches.
- Mac: pass ENGRAM_SOURCE_BINARY=/Users/greg/GitHub/Personal/Engram-runner/target/pinned/engram-source-890ecb6f2566923536a85d3547fd1314847564fb (sha256 b68c4dfd…991e, build f4267d06f6db). Old pins are kept.
Never install outside the repo without Greg's word. Refresh the pins explicitly and on the record after a landing that changes the owner. Tests always point at the candidate's own build.
5. STANDING RUNNER CLEANUP: when the census refuses an Engram job for lack of space, the runner may delete Cargo build output under its own finished jobs' target/, oldest first and only as much as needed. Use checked absolute paths inside the clone, with no symlinks leading out. KEEP worktrees, target/tmp and home, inputs, review-runs, logs, fixtures and target/pinned. Never touch an active job or a protected TermAl lane. Log each deletion in .logs/ and report it in the next END.
